desc: Read N, S, T from stdin, check S == T case, build `need` mapping with conflict detection.
Clean up the code: remove the abandoned BFS/DFS section, keep only the Union-Find implementation.
Verify cycle detection: for each Union-Find component, compare edge count to node count. If equal and > 0, the component has a cycle requiring one extra operation.
Test edge cases: N=1, all 26 letters forming one cycle, multiple components with mixed cycle/tree structures.
Ensure self-loops (c == need[c]) are excluded from edge counts and node counts correctly.
